The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f028b02be7ed3140), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Under the hypotheses of Proposition 2.6, any chosen positive fiber of any k-model can be moved to s = 1 by positive diagonal changes in s and normalized by an invertible linear change in y so that Br0 ⊂ K1 ⊂ BR0 , r0 = 2 C∗ + 1 , R0 = 2m. For every fixed 0 < a < 1 < b, these normalized models satisfy (2.8) Bar0 ⊂ Ks ⊂ BbR0 (s ∈ [a, b]k ). Their caps for fixed positive linear forms in s and fixed positive top levels have uniform bounds, and they contain a fixed interior ball about (1, 0). For any sequence of affine images of D converging to one of these models, comparable cap and fiber bounds hold eventually, uniformly on each fixed positive box. The constants are independent of the chosen fiber; the required index may depend on its normalization. For finitely many chosen fibers, one index suffices for all of them.
